theorem probe_nv_instance (nu : ℝ) :
    NavierStokes.Comparator.NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn (n := 3) nu
      (fun _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun _ _ => 0) where
  navier_stokes := by
    intro x t ht
    first
      | simp
      | simp [show (fun _ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) => (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))) = 0 from rfl]
  div_free := by
    intro x t ht
    exact NavierStokes.Comparator.divergence_zero x
  initial_condition := by intro x; rfl
  velocity_smooth := contDiffOn_const
  pressure_smooth := contDiffOn_const
  integrable := by
    intro t ht
    simpa using (MeasureTheory.MemLp.zero : MeasureTheory.MemLp (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ) 2 MeasureTheory.volume)
  globally_bounded_energy := ⟨1, by intro t ht; simp⟩
